# CICH Profile

> A comprehensive health surveillance system tracking indicators for Canadian children and youth across multiple dimensions of wellbeing and development.

CICH Profile is maintained by the Canadian Institute of Child Health and provides evidence-based health data aligned with the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. The platform organizes health information into thematic modules covering demographics, early development, genetics, primary care, nutrition, indigenous health, and immigrant populations.

## Key Topics

- Child health
- Youth health
- Health indicators
- Health outcomes
- Primary care
- Child development
- Pediatric genetics
- Indigenous health
- Immigrant and refugee health
- Canadian demographics
- Vulnerable populations
- Mental health
- Congenital anomalies
- Early childhood development
- UN Convention on the Rights of the Child

## Core Framework & Organization

- [The Health of Canada's Children and Youth](https://cichprofile.ca): CICH Profile homepage tracking health indicators for Canadian children and youth
- [La santé des enfants et des jeunes](https://cichprofile.ca/fr): French language version of CICH Profile health data for Canadian youth
- [About CICH](https://cichprofile.ca/about-the-profile/about-cich): Canadian Institute of Child Health organization background and mission
- [Framework](https://cichprofile.ca/about-the-profile/framework): CICH Profile framework overview and health measurement methodology
- [Guiding Principles](https://cichprofile.ca/about-the-profile/guiding-principles): Core principles guiding CICH Profile framework aligned with UN Convention
- [Module Pages Overview](https://cichprofile.ca/module): Overview of all CICH Profile modules on child and youth health topics

## Health Modules & Topics

- [Children and Youth in Canada: The Context of their Lives](https://cichprofile.ca/module/1): Canadian children demographics, family structure, and health outcomes
- [Health and Development in the Early Years](https://cichprofile.ca/module/8): Early childhood development, prenatal care, and social determinants module
- [Genetics and Paediatric Health](https://cichprofile.ca/module/2): Genetics primer, genetic testing, and congenital anomalies in Canadian youth
- [Primary Health Care Services for Children and Youth in Canada](https://cichprofile.ca/module/3): Primary care access, healthcare structure, and medical homes across Canada
- [Health Profile on Immigrant and Refugee Children and Youth in Canada](https://cichprofile.ca/module/4): Immigrant and refugee children health status and vaccination screening
- [Indigenous Children and Youth](https://cichprofile.ca/module/7): Indigenous children health outcomes and community programs in Canada
- [Growing Healthy Bodies](https://cichprofile.ca/module/9): Module on child nutrition, physical activity, and body image in Canada

## Leadership & Partners

- [National Advisory Group](https://cichprofile.ca/partners/national-advisory-group): National Advisory Group members and health leadership for CICH Profile
- [Expert Advisory Committees](https://cichprofile.ca/partners/expert-advisory-committees): Expert committees covering mental health, indigenous, and environmental health

## Support & Information

- [FAQs](https://cichprofile.ca/about-the-profile/faqs): Frequently asked questions about CICH Profile data sources and usage
